build_neb_frames_dissociation: build NEB frames for a dissociation reaction using AutoFrameDissociation with a calculator and n_frames
build_neb_frames_transfer: build NEB frames for a transfer reaction using AutoFrameTransfer with initial and final frame candidates
build_neb_frames_desorption: build NEB frames for a desorption reaction using AutoFrameDesorption with a z_desorption distance
interpolate_frames_between_initial_final: interpolate between initial and final ASE Atoms frames and correct for atomic overlap
check_adsorbate_adsorbed_on_surface: check if an adsorbate is adsorbed on a surface slab using covalent radius distance ratios
